topic: Day 83 — reel — A boundary is a fence, not a wall — it shows people how to stay in
text:
A boundary
is a [fence].
It shows people
how to stay.
caption:
Boundaries get heard as rejection when the function is clarity. Relationships with clear ones are usually more stable, not less.
